decision.implementation_scope: Add a deterministic mean-reversion structural evaluator and focused tests. Freeze its causal signal/response alignment, hypothesis parameters, statistic, missing-data and censoring rules, minimum evidence requirements, and multiplicity correction before outcome evaluation; run it on the accepted 13-week M5 data for all 41 representatives. Do not reuse or tune the trend-momentum diagnostic, open economic outcomes, or authorize trading.
decision.method: Use the existing mean-reversion hypothesis definition to freeze a causal, non-economic structural test, its parameters, outcome statistic, and multiplicity control before evaluating accepted M5 data. Report support and data sufficiency without economic promotion.

scope.identity_basis: Fresh prospective structural screen; no consumed identity reruns.
scope.symbols: All 41 current structural representatives; do not treat representatives as economically equivalent or narrow scope without frontier-relative, outcome-independent justification.

next_research_state.implementation_scope: Implement and test the prospectively frozen mean-reversion structural evaluator specified in the decision; evaluate only after its law is fixed.

objective.goal: Test a prospectively frozen mean-reversion hypothesis across the current 41 structurally distinct representatives using accepted 13-week M5 data.
objective.information_gain_rationale: The latest frozen trend-momentum screen found no supported symbols but left that family open. A distinct mean-reversion screen tests a complementary mechanism across the complete representative breadth, without retuning the observed trend diagnostic or narrowing scope based on its result.
